scope: MFData-only dormant code, not live permissions or Insights implementation
read_semantics: All columns/rows exposed by existing and future data objects in enrolled fund/research schemas. SELECT is a business-data read entitlement, not proof that a value is valid, current, human-verified, licensed for public redistribution or suitable for comparison. Existing financial/provenance/quality semantics stay authoritative.
coverage: Public prepare(catalogue) reports present/absent schemas and a deterministic read-only privilege delta. Schema-local creator defaults apply only to future objects created by mfdata_admin. New columns on a SELECT-granted object are readable without a new per-column grant. Entirely new schemas, other creators and foreign tables are NOT claimed covered. Creator/default semantics are PostgreSQL rules, not hidden per-fund restrictions.
schema_custody: The fixed 16 schemas include original fund data, source documents, fund-related operations and review metadata. Before live application the owner must attest no credentials/unrelated personal data in those schemas and approve all-row/shared-consumer exposure. Private custom role/function settings remain server-sealed metadata, never plaintext evidence. No grant to public/system/unrelated schemas, no global read-all role, no grant option, writes or additional EXECUTE. Database owners remain trusted: this policy cannot inspect future cell contents or prevent arbitrary administrative changes.
code_delivery: Design-before-code; provider-free tests locally; native PostgreSQL tests ONLY disposable CI; all original checks/contracts/image/native tests; named exact-head review; normal merge and independently admitted main. Historical files, installer SQL, numbered migrations, policies, financial code, source/PDF paths, dependency lock and CI remain unchanged. No local PG/Docker or existing job retry.
live_preparation_NOT_currently_authorize: Deliver final exact reviewed code and independently admitted main before final image preparation; do not reuse earlier-Git images as new-Git authority.

Use a separately reviewed fixed runtime transport; no secret lookup/connection/cloud operation is provided by this module. Existing narrow84+2 operator is frozen and cannot execute this profile by substitution.

Bind fresh whole catalogue, exact generated before/after/plan/profile hashes, final Git/image/program, existing owner SA/secret-reference, schema-custody/provisioning/admin-window attestations and one-operation limits into a canonical human exact-write approval. A matching Permit fingerprint only binds bytes, it does NOT prove that approval.

Owner's current/future data-schema custody and exclusive administration/provisioning window are explicit external trust boundaries. Foreign tables and RLS fail admission. No claim of arbitrary-admin immunity or permanent postcommit access.

Only the finally approved operator may persist its create-only intent and invoke apply on one already-connected idle owner connection. Original 5s/5s/15s limits and existing request/environment limits stay unchanged. No role fallback, extra query, retries or resource increases.
future_provisioning_composition: Existing/default-enrolled schemas: creator mfdata_admin creates new tables/views in its separately approved provisioning transaction. Future read privileges arise from its schema-local default ACL; require_current_policy on complete fresh metadata must pass before publication.

New fund-data schema: classify/declare/enroll it in a reviewed version of the domain profile and use public prepare to obtain deterministic owner operations inside the separately reviewed installer transaction. The pure guard runs before install COMMIT. Do not call apply from an active transaction or use private engine helpers.

Different object creator, foreign table, RLS, private-data placement or old privilege-reset installer means STOP that provisioning composition for a reviewed disposition. No false claim these are automatically supported; no existing installer is modified or made safe by this PR.
failure_and_reversal: Precommit failure confirms one rollback or explicitly reports abort unconfirmed; no SQL after spent wall. COMMIT exception or postcommit verification failure stops with unknown/unverified outcome; no retry/reconnect/autoreversal. Persist the exact missing-grant/default delta before execution. Separate reversal authority is required and must account for every object created later under defaults: revoking a default does not revoke grants inherited by already-created objects. No generic revoke-all/CASCADE or automatic rollback after committed state.

acceptance_boundary: This milestone adds a reviewed broad access mechanism and tests. It does not apply live privileges, certify latency, complete FS13, activate sources or authorize NSE/EXP execution. Runtime FS13K, source/NAV/audit schedules and all original preservation/financial proofs stay unchanged.
